_about: The places of 徐 — a map, not a chain. `roads` go both ways; `tier` is the ladder index a place asks for (0 练气 … 8 渡劫), and a place above the player's tier is refused in the mist with a fitting place to go instead. `has` says what is there: a creature with its card, the province's seed pool, the market, a chapter scene. `line` is one sentence of what is there, for the director's brief.
_pools: 游荡的怪 (Hanli, 2026-10-05: 一片地方一个游荡怪物池，可重复打): a pool is a stretch of country's beasts and their weights; a place joins it by `has.pool` (world.mjs poolBeast). Only beasts of 卷一's book and a few added: 蒙山's are a hunter's trade (野猪 · 狼 · 熊), 狰 runs wild outside the herb garden (with 蒙山's 狼 and 熊 there too from 古四, 2026-10-21: the 狰 tamed at the 药园 leaves the pool, and 观内 has no other), 蠪侄 in the wood outside the gate (古三), 蛫 by the Si (古五's 秘境). An entry's `deck` is how the pool deals that beast (world.mjs foeOf): 蠪侄 and 狰 are the story's fights too, and their scenes keep the creature's own deck — the pool's is weighed in 蛫's band (tools/battle-sim.mjs --pools). The 秘境's rooms (2026-10-15): 犰狳 on the 凶崖's stair (见人则眠 — it lies across the way playing dead) and in the dry river with 合窳 (见则天下大水 — the river that floods again in three days); 犰狳's pool deck is weighed into 蛫's band.
_games_pool: 今日棋局 (Hanli 2026-10-27: 「目前就只能战斗刷经验吗? 好像没什么任务能做, 感觉卡在了一个小地图」 → 「可以, 加吧」): a place of the 观 keeps a pool of two or three of the kit's practice boards (`has.games_pool: {from, today}`), and `today` of them stand there each day beside its fixed `games`, turning with the day — the same on every device and save (rules/rotation.mjs). Only boards that deal a new level a sitting (拼图 · 华容道 climb, 五子 a rival by realm and seed); 象棋 only at 执事堂, its few endgames (games/xiangqi.js PUZZLES: three a level) not spread thin; 洛书 stays at its one gate (Hanli 10-19: 「9宫格出现一次就可以了」). A board a wall tag names at a place stands there on any day the tag is in the book.
_plates: A painted map of one small area (观内, 2026-10-15): the 去往 list opens on it while he stands on one of its places — each place's `plate.at`, fractions of the painting, set on the painted building (rules/plate.mjs, scripts/plate.js). 沉鼎观 is tools/paint-guan.py seed 47, picked 2026-10-15. A plate with no `file` is drawn in ink, its places as seals on paper (沉鼎秘境's rooms, plate.js); a `sealed` plate's places are an instance's rooms, seen only from inside it (world.mjs hiddenRoom).

name.en: The stair of the Cliff of Danger

line.zh: 泗水南岸，芦苇齐人高，你拾到铃的地方。
line.en: The south bank of the Si, reeds as tall as you — where you found the bell.

line.zh: 雾常年不散。往北一条土路，通冀州的漳水。
line.en: The mist never lifts. A dirt road runs north to the Zhang in Ji.

line.zh: 徐州的城，坊市在南门里。
line.en: The city of Xu; the market lies inside the south gate.

line.zh: 山形如卧龙，山上有石床，传说仙人在此醉卧。
line.en: A hill shaped like a sleeping dragon, a stone bed on top where an immortal is said to have slept off his wine.

line.zh: 一条船，一个老船家。渡人，不渡心事。
line.en: One boat, one old boatman. He carries people, not their troubles.

line.zh: 下邳的老桥。当年一位老人在桥上掉了鞋，一个少年替他拾了三次。
line.en: The old bridge at Xiapi. An old man once dropped his shoe here; a young man picked it up three times.

line.zh: 泗水入淮之处，两水相激，船家在此歇桨。
line.en: Where the Si meets the Huai; two waters collide, and boatmen rest their oars.

line.zh: 泗水最险的一段，石齿如林，水声如雷。
line.en: The wildest stretch of the Si: rocks like teeth, water like thunder.

line.zh: 大泽无边，芦苇里藏着走蛇的小路。
line.en: A marsh without edges; snake-paths hide in the reeds.

line.zh: 湖上千顷荷，湖心有岛，岛上有古墓。
line.en: A thousand acres of lotus; an island at the heart, and an old tomb on the island.

line.zh: 徐州得名之山，山顶终年有云。
line.en: The mountain the province is named for; clouds sit on its top all year.

line.zh: 大泽无边。西狩获麟的地方。
line.en: A marsh without end. Where the unicorn was taken in the western hunt.

line.zh: 山里有婴儿的哭声，不是婴儿。
line.en: In the hills a sound of infants crying. Not infants.

line.zh: 一株空心的桑树。伊尹生在这儿。
line.en: A hollow mulberry. Yi Yin was born here.

line.zh: 彭城下的深水，始皇的绳子在这里断过。
line.en: The deep water under Pengcheng, where the First Emperor's rope once broke.

line.zh: 渡叔的船拴在这里，一盏灯挂在桩上，大水天也不灭。
line.en: Du Shu's boat is tied here, a lantern on the post that stays lit even in the floods.

line.zh: 往沉鼎观的石径，沟深草密，三年一回挤满上山的孩子。
line.en: The stone path up to Chending Temple: deep ditches, thick grass, and once in three years, crowded with children climbing.

line.zh: 三百级石阶顶上一座旧山门，瞿老守在门里，谁进谁出都要过他那一关。
line.en: An old gate at the top of three hundred steps. Elder Qu keeps it; no one comes or goes without passing him.

line.zh: 正殿里没有神像，只有一口空的石座，四方，四足。
line.en: No statue in the main hall — only an empty stone seat, square, on four feet.

line.zh: 外门的院子：晒着的柴，井边的水桶，周衡的账本。
line.en: The outer court: firewood drying, buckets by the well, Zhou Heng's ledger.

keeper.en: the pedlar of the south road

line.zh: 蒙山脚下十七户人家，十六户种地，一户打猎——你家。
line.en: Seventeen households at the foot of Mount Meng: sixteen farm, one hunts — yours.

name.en: The front slopes of Mount Meng

line.zh: 马家的山。三场围猎把前山篦了一遍又一遍，满地狗爪印。
line.en: The Mas' mountain. Three autumn hunts combed the front slopes bare; dog tracks everywhere.

name.en: Black Pine Ridge · The broken stele

line.zh: 岭口的断碑，只剩两个字还看得清：勿入。
line.en: The broken stele at the ridge mouth; only two characters still read: Do not enter.

line.zh: 树比外面的高一倍，树皮黑得像铁；路会自己打结。
line.en: Trees twice as tall as outside, bark black as iron; the paths tie themselves in knots.

line.zh: 崖下的山谷，银叶树上挂着露珠，草叶踩下去会发亮。
line.en: The vale under the cliff: silver-leaved trees hung with dew, grass that glows where you step.

line.zh: 外门的讲堂：一排排矮桌，褚先生的山羊胡子一翘一翘。每日辰时上课。
line.en: The outer court's lecture hall: rows of low desks, and Master Chu's goat beard bobbing. Lessons every morning at the hour of the dragon.

line.zh: 藏经阁七层，外门弟子只许上三层。最顶层的门上一把铜锁，锁眼都绿了。你走近的时候，胸口的木牌烫了一下，一个很困的声音：「……九鼎……神丹……」然后就没声了。
line.en: Seven floors, and outer disciples may climb only three. The top floor's door has a bronze lock gone green in the keyhole. As you come near, the token on your chest flares, and a very sleepy voice: "…Nine cauldrons… divine elixir…" Then nothing.

line.zh: 外门后院的柴房，挨着伙房和猪圈。外门也有柴堆——你觉得这是缘分。
line.en: The woodshed behind the outer court, by the kitchen and the pigsty. The outer court has a woodpile too — you call that fate.

line.zh: 药园一片银白。最里面那株最贵的紫玉参旁边，夜里常有「咔嚓、咔嚓」的声音。园门上挂着一块牌子：药园重地，偷者必究。
line.en: The herb garden lies silver-white. Beside the costliest purple jade ginseng at the far end, at night, there is often a crunch, crunch. A board on the gate: Herb garden. Thieves will be pursued.

line.zh: 后山崖顶，一块比人还高的大青石。往下看是泗水，泗水再往北，是蒙山。
line.en: The cliff top behind the temple, a blue boulder taller than a person. Below runs the Si; north of the Si, Mount Meng.

line.zh: 山脚的坊市，一条街，卖符纸的、卖灵草的、卖萝卜的。钱掌柜的铺子最大，算盘打得最响。
line.en: The market at the foot of the mountain: one street of talisman paper, spirit herbs and radishes. Shopkeeper Qian's is the biggest stall, and his abacus the loudest.

name.en: The hidden realm · The stone door

line.zh: 泗水底下有一道石门。每十年，泗水退一次潮，露出它来。沉鼎观的名字，就是从这里来的。
line.en: Under the Si there is a stone door. Once every ten years the river draws back and shows it. the Sunken Cauldron Abbey takes its name from it.

name.en: The hidden realm · The forking hall

line.zh: 石门里头一间大石厅，七八个口子张着嘴。人都往人多的里头挤；最边上一道窄缝，石头上刻着一个「凶」字。
line.en: Inside the stone door, a great stone hall, seven or eight openings gaping. Everyone squeezes into the crowded ones; at the far edge a narrow fissure has 凶, "danger", cut above it.

name.en: The hidden realm · The Cliff of Danger

say.zh: 石阶当中卧着一只犰狳，见了人便倒下装死，一动不动地堵着路。
say.en: A qiuyu lies across the stair; at the sight of you it drops and plays dead, blocking the way without a twitch.

line.zh: 「凶」字底下的石缝一路往下，越走越窄。脚底下的石阶湿滑，崖口黑得不见底。
line.en: Below the 凶 the fissure runs down, narrower at every step. The stone steps are slick underfoot, and the drop is black to the bottom.

name.en: The hidden realm · Below the drop

line.zh:
他把袖子挽起来，顺着崖壁往下爬。他是猎户家的孩子，爬崖是本行，可这道崖从上到下一根草也不长，石头凉得透骨。他左边的肋骨，十月十二那夜断的，到这时候还没长牢，一使劲，便像有人往里头塞了一根针。

崖下一道窄窄的石台，一面光秃秃的石墙——墙后头，有风。墙脚一汪半干的水潭。
line.en:
He rolled up his sleeves and climbed down the cliff face. He was a hunter's child, and climbing cliffs was his trade, but this cliff grew not a blade of grass from top to bottom, and the rock was cold to the bone. His left ribs, broken that night of the twelfth of the tenth month, still hadn't knitted, and every time he strained, it felt as if someone were pushing a needle in.

Below the cliff, a narrow stone ledge and a bare stone wall — behind the wall, there is wind. At its foot, a half-dry pool.

places._line: The climb down is told here since 2026-10-19 (下崖 cut): the book's paragraph whole (05-第五回.md), then the room.

name.en: The hidden realm · The cliff wall

line.zh: 石台外沿是崖壁，一根锈烂的铁橛子钉在崖沿上；再往外，就是不见底的崖口。
line.en: The ledge's outer edge is the cliff wall, a rusted iron stake driven into its lip; beyond it, the bottomless drop.

name.en: The hidden realm · The stone chamber

line.zh: 墙后一间石室，方方正正，四壁青石磨得照得出人影。地上四个方坑，正中一张石台。
line.en: Behind the wall, a square stone chamber, its blue-stone walls polished to a mirror. Four square pits in the floor; a stone altar in the middle.

name.en: The hidden realm · The dry river

line.zh: 石室西北角那个半人高的黑洞，一路往下，通到一条干了的暗河。黑里，风是暖的。
line.en: The waist-high black hole in the chamber's northwest corner runs down and down to a dry underground river. In the dark, the wind is warm.

line.zh: 饭堂门口摆一张榆木桌子，初一发灵石，周衡坐在后头。饭是糙米，菜是萝卜。
line.en: A elm-wood table stands at the dining-hall door; on the first of the month Zhou Heng sits behind it handing out spirit stones. The rice is coarse, the vegetable is radish.

visitor._about: 货郎上山 (Hanli, 2026-10-15: 「按A做, 货郎上山摆摊」): while 外门弟子 may not go down (观内), a pedlar pays the 观 its 摊钱 and sets up under the cypresses for a day, every third day — 古六's precedent (外人上不得山; 钱掌柜 pays ten 灵石 and is let up at 大比, here at the 五行台). Not 石坳村's 走南路的货郎 (古二's teller of the 岷江 baby): another pedlar, unnamed. No 押宝. Sells 符 at 20 (Hanli 2026-10-15 「yes」: 钱掌柜's 符箓 are canon); never buys it back. rules/visiting.mjs.

keeper.zh: 丹药 · 杂货 · 收药材皮货
keeper.en: pills and sundries; buys herbs and hides

say.zh: 「药材皮货我收。别的，担子挑不下山。」
say.en: "Herbs and hides I take. Anything else won't fit on the pole going down."

line.zh: 老柏底下歇着一副货郎担子。货郎交过周衡的摊钱，汗还没干：「三百级台阶，一级一文都不止。丹药、针线，看看。」
line.en: Under the old cypresses rests a pedlar's pole. He has paid Zhou Heng the stall fee and is still sweating: "Three hundred steps, and every one worth more than a coin. Pills, needle and thread — have a look."

line.zh: 外门的演武场。五块青石板拼成一个圆，缝里长出了草，叫五行台。四角立着四棵老柏。
line.en: The outer court's training ground. Five bluestone slabs make a circle with grass in the cracks — the Five Phases Stage. An old cypress stands at each corner.

shop._about: 外门库房 (2026-10-27, Hanli on 古四: 「现在看地图也不知到商店在哪里」 — 外门弟子无令不得下山, so the 坊市 is shut to him until the story sends him down, and the pedlar comes one day in three): 周衡 keeps the 公中 store in the stewards' hall and sells to disciples against 灵石, from 古四's 小周天 on. Stock for the 练气一层 hand: 回春丹 · 回气丹, 钱掌柜's three cards (consigned), a 竹剑.

keeper.en: Zhou Heng, on the common account

line.zh: 正殿西边一间空屋，没有神像，只有两面墙。东墙挂乌木牌，杂役，外门也揭得；揭一块，办一桩。下山的牌子，揭了才有令。
line.en: An empty room west of the main hall: no statue, only two walls. Ebony tags hang on the east wall — chores an outer disciple may take too; take one, do one. A tag for work below the mountain comes with a pass.
